name: Incident Response
description: Respond to production incident — outage, data loss, security breach, or degradation.

default_promises.description: Mitigate the incident and restore service

example_contract:
CONTRACT: CTR-INCIDENT01
  TYPE: INCIDENT:OUTAGE
  SCOPE: [affected services]
  MODULES: [affected modules]
  RISK CAP: CRITICAL
  PROMISES:
    1. Mitigate → verify: manual_review
    2. Root cause → verify: diff_inspection
    3. Post-mortem → verify: manual_review
  STATUS: proposed
